### What is it?

*Metadata is data about data.  It describes the information and context needed to understand and interpret the data.*

### Common metadata standards in ocean science

[Ecological Metadata Language (EML)](https://eml.ecoinformatics.org/)

 - For ecological and environmental data of many types
 - Widely used, tools in R to write it
 
[ISO 19115](https://www.dcc.ac.uk/resources/metadata-standards/iso-19115) 

 - For geographic information, primarily
 - Mandated by the US Federal Government

[Darwin Core](https://dwc.tdwg.org/)

 - For biological observations and related info
 - Implemented by repositories such as OBIS and GBIF

[Climate & Forecast (CF)](https://cfconventions.org/)

 - Built into NetCDF file format
